models.name: KEEP_5000_AS_CURRENT_WHOLE_HELPER_BOUND
models.security: Retains existing fail-closed whole-process availability bound, aggregate20s/CLI30s, no retry, complete native observations and strict settled-before-deadline acceptance.
models.eligibility: Explicit whole-lifecycle intent is established; credible representative margin and variance assessment remain measurement questions.

models.name: KEEP_5000_AS_REQUEST_EXECUTION_BOUND
models.security: Excluding startup creates an acquisition period that must have a separately authorized finite bound, counted with aggregate/CLI admission, cancellation, cleanup and no overlap. A pipe-write or client-asserted ready signal cannot authorize a clock reset or attest trusted request execution.
models.eligibility: Current normative text expressly includes startup. Current intent does not support B without a substantive separately authorized contract/clock-placement correction. No reliableT3 means these observations alone may not isolate a5s request-work interval.

models.name: RECHARACTERIZE_WHOLE_HELPER_BOUND
models.security: A longer bound increases per-invocation resource/denial-of-service exposure. Future authority must evaluate interaction with aggregate20s, CLI30s, nine/four serial requests, strict equality and bounded cleanup; none may silently expand or reset.
models.eligibility: Only if measurement demonstrates insufficient whole-lifecycle engineering margin. A future bound method must use representative raw tails, observer uncertainty and declared reserve; do not select6000ms from one5063mssettlement.

invariants: No persistent helper/service/pool/sidecar or PowerShell7 redesign
No deadline equality relaxation, retries or later-success promotion
Fresh complete native identity/chain/security checks remain unchanged
Historical timeout/cleanup uncertainty and blocked3A-R remain unchanged
No shipping bytes change; accepted exact-C3RB3B-R/3C-R authorities remain applicable in their existing scope

safeExternalObservation.rights: Read-only process query/synchronize and memory-info rights for retained helper and positively attributed child conhost. No terminate rights, injection, admin requirement or external installation.
safeExternalObservation.identity: Bind PID to creation time, image identity and parent relation; retain native handles to resistPID reuse. Polling can miss short-lived consoles; report that limitation.
safeExternalObservation.metrics: GetProcessTimes CPU/creation/exit, working set, bounded process-count and available-memory/systemCPU snapshots. No commandline/environment dump or unrelated process content retention.
safeExternalObservation.interpretation: Elapsed greater than attributableCPU is compatible with waits/scheduling; it does not identify scheduler/Defender causation. Multi-thread CPU can exceed elapsed, and sampling overhead/gaps must be measured.
safeExternalObservation.limits: One predeclared finite query-only observer; no additional product helpers, induced timeouts, adaptive retries or machine tuning.

uncertainty: No A/B/C recommendation is made here; measurement and margin records must supply remaining evidence.
